note: A time on an arc pip (SPEC 3.3.2). An arc is geometry shared by every highlight that walks it, and a time belongs to one recording, so an arc pip carries none. The remedy drops the time channel and keeps everything else: all three pips survive with their positions and elevations, and the highlight that walks the arc survives. ONE diagnostic, at the arc's `pips`, although two pips carry a time: the fact is about the arc, and a recorded arc of a thousand pips is one fact, not a thousand (SPEC 6.3 rule 3). The middle pip carries no time, so a reader that reported per pip rather than per arc emits two diagnostics at two paths and fails. `positions` pins the pips on either side of it, so a reader that dropped a timed pip instead of its time channel fails too.

diagnostics.message_advisory: an arc pip carries no time — the time channels are dropped
